description: This Java class 'ShipmentWorker' provides utility methods for handling shipment-related calculations and operations within the Apache OFBiz framework, including package content value calculation, package splitting based on weight constraints, and package weight calculation.

classes.name: ShipmentWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing shipment-related calculations and operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getShipmentPackageContentValue
methods.description: Calculates the value of a shipment package content based on related item issuances and order items, without rounding.

methods.name: getPackageSplit
methods.description: Splits shippable items into packages based on maximum weight constraints.

methods.name: calcPackageWeight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of a package, converting units to pounds if necessary.

methods.name: getProductItemInfo
methods.description: Retrieves product information from a list based on product ID.
